# Fictionary

> Fictionary is book writing and editing software designed to help authors and professional editors develop, structure, and refine manuscripts through developmental editing tools.

Fictionary offers a suite of products including StoryTeller for individual authors and StoryCoach for professional editors, along with a directory of certified editors and comprehensive educational resources on story structure and writing craft.

## Key Topics

- StoryTeller
- StoryCoach
- Story Arc
- Story Map
- Developmental Editing
- Manuscript Editing
- Story Structure
- Story Elements
- Character Development
- Novel Writing Software
- Book Editing Software
- Story Goal Tracker
- Outlining Templates
- Creative Writing
- Video Tutorials

## Core Products

- [StoryTeller | Developmental Editing](https://fictionary.co/products/storyteller): StoryTeller developmental editing software with Story Map and Arc tools
- [StoryCoach: Online Book Editing Software](https://fictionary.co/products/storycoach): StoryCoach software for professional editors with client management
- [StoryCoach Edit: Hire a Certified Book Editor](https://fictionary.co/products/storycoach-edit): StoryCoach Edit: hire certified editors for developmental editing services
- [Fictionary Homepage](https://fictionary.co): Book writing and editing software for authors

## Writing & Story Structure Guides

- [Story Elements: Definition and Examples](https://fictionary.co/journal/story-elements): Guide to 9 essential story elements for plot, character, and setting
- [What is a Story Arc: Definition and Examples from Books](https://fictionary.co/journal/the-story-arc-why-stories-captivate): Story arc definition covering narrative structure and plot points
- [Inciting Incident Definition and Examples](https://fictionary.co/journal/inciting-incident-2): Inciting incident definition and role in three-act story structure
- [What is the Climax of a Story? Definition and Examples](https://fictionary.co/journal/the-climax-in-the-context-of-the-story-arc): Story climax definition with examples from Gone Girl and The Martian
- [Best Book Editing Software 2025: Top 5 Tools for Writers](https://fictionary.co/journal/best-book-editing-software): Comparison of top 5 book editing software tools for writers
